title: Jesus... Why Am I Nervous To Serve At Church Again? 😊
topic: she signed up to serve at her church again after months away, and keeps telling herself she is busy, not scared

bible.text: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I signed up to serve at church again. Sunday. 😊

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Third Sunday I've said ‘I'll confirm tomorrow’. Tomorrow never comes, and the volunteer chat has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not scared of serving. You're scared of being seen trying.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: They knew me before. What if I'm not that person anymore?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not returning to a stage. You're reporting for grace.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The good works were prepared before you were. Just show up.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What would you serve this Sunday? 👇
